title: Create Trictrac python game template
description:
Create a python trictrac game definition in open_spiel/python/games/trictrac.py. Only write constants and function signatures, don't fully implement functions.

Warning: Trictrac is a tables game related to backgammon in terms of board and pieces, but it differs in rules and strategic philosophy.

To model the game state and the action space, you can look at the following files in doc/trictrac_project which is a rust implementation of trictrac rules:

- store/src/game.rs for the game state
- bot/src/training_common.rs for the actions space
